name: Arc
title: Arc
description: A desktop developer workspace built with Tauri (Rust) and React (TypeScript). Unifies a real PTY-backed terminal, an embedded code editor, a git-aware file tree, source control, SSH, and a REST API client into one interface. Optional panels drive Claude Code and Wingman agents.

name: dlm
title: DLM
description: A high-performance local LLM inference engine written in Rust. Dynamically streams transformer layers to break VRAM limitations and run massive models on consumer hardware.

name: Wingman
title: Wingman
description: Multi-provider terminal coding agent in Rust — bring your own model   (Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Ollama, OpenRouter)

name: kortex-memory
title: Kortex Memory
description: Production-grade, multi-tenant memory layer for LLMs and AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode). Plug it in via MCP and your agents get a shared, durable, scoped, access-controlled memory that survives across sessions and tools.

name: Aegis
title: Aegis
description: Aegis is an automated, continuous penetration testing SaaS. It utilizes an autonomous multi-agent AI framework to dynamically execute code in isolated sandboxes. Aegis detects, exploits, and validates real security vulnerabilities, providing developers with zero-false-positive reports and actionable AI-generated remediation

name: zero
title: Zero
description: A privacy-first, AI-native web browser with its own rendering engine, built from scratch in Rust

name: clifi
title: CLIFi
description: A terminal-native personal finance tracker written in Rust. Log expenses headlessly or via an   interactive wizard, import bank CSVs with rule-based auto-categorization, and browse a ratatui dashboard with vim-style navigation, a searchable/filterable ledger, and category spending charts. Local-first data stays in a JSON file, no cloud, no accounts

name: Echo
title: Echo
description: Echo is a privacy-first, cross-platform voice keyboard: press a hotkey, speak, and Echo transcribes your speech and types it into whatever app is focused. Transcription runs locally (Whisper) or via cloud providers (OpenAI, Groq, Deepgram) — your choice.

name: ROCm-Studio
title: ROCm Studio
description: Mission control for the ROCm ecosystem — App for AMD GPU developers

name: Arc-Data-Factory
title: Arc Data Factory
description: Production-grade platform for collecting, cleaning, deduplicating, classifying, scoring, tokenizing, and sharding AI training datasets for ARC models (300M → 1B → 10B+ roadmap)
